claims.text: The resort sits where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez, on the southern tip of Mexico's Baja California Peninsula.

findings.quote: Relaxation and renewal await where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez on the southern tip of Mexico’s Baja California Peninsula.

claims.text: The resort covers 24 acres and is carved into the mountain.

findings.quote: our 24-acre, Forbes Five-Star resort and spa carved into the mountain

claims.text: Stays come with bespoke service from the resort's butlers and Personal Concierge team.

findings.quote: bespoke service by our Butlers and Personal Concierge team

claims.text: Guests are welcomed in their room with a bottle of premium tequila as a gift.

findings.quote: a bottle of Premium Tequila, our gift to you, will welcome you in your room

claims.text: Don Manuel's serves casual breakfast and lunch, then turns into fine dining in the evening with live local musicians.

findings.quote: Satisfy daytime cravings with breakfast or lunch in a laid-back hacienda atmosphere.
Casual daytime dining transitions a gourmet fine dining experience in the evening as warm lighting and live local musicians set the scene

claims.text: El Farallon's Champagne Terrace offers a curated collection of 20 rotating champagnes.

findings.quote: Explore a curated collection of 20 unique, rotating champagnes on the restaurant’s Champagne Terrace

claims.text: Mar y Lena is the resort's signature steakhouse, with wood-fired cooking at The Beach Club Palapa.

findings.quote: Experience an unforgettable evening at The Beach Club Palapa
Mar y Leña is our signature steakhouse— an intimate culinary journey that blends wood-fired cooking

claims.text: The spa's wet-area grottos have steam rooms, saunas, ice rooms and whirlpools.

findings.quote: Wet area grottos feature steam rooms, saunas, ice rooms, and whirlpools

claims.text: The Intention spa treatment was developed with local curanderos and shamans and includes an energy cleansing ritual, craniosacral therapy and a Mexican folk massage.

findings.quote: Developed alongside local curanderos and shamans, the Intention includes an energy cleansing ritual, craniosacral therapy, and a Mexican folk massage.

claims.text: Complimentary yoga classes are offered, and there are two tennis courts with a tennis pro.

findings.quote: Start your day with complimentary yoga classes, reserve time with one of our fitness instructors, or let our tennis pro assist in brushing up your game on one of two tennis courts.

claims.text: From December to April, small-group whale watching trips follow the whales' annual migration.

findings.quote: From December to April, ride a high-speed boat with a small group and watch the whales' annual migration.

claims.text: Excursions include Panga reef cruises, surfing lessons, breakfast on the resort's private yacht and farm-to-table lunches in Todos Santos.

findings.quote: Choose adventures from Panga reef cruises and surfing lessons to breakfast on our private yacht and farm-to-table lunches in Todos Santos.

claims.text: Guests enter the resort through the private Dos Mares tunnel.

findings.quote: Enter paradise through the private Dos Mares tunnel

claims.text: Every accommodation has its own private plunge pool and Pacific Ocean views.

findings.quote: Every accommodation features its own private plunge pool and Pacific Ocean views.

claims.text: At El Farallon, overlooking the Pacific, the local fishermen's catch is prepared in an open-air kitchen.

findings.quote: Overlooking the Pacific Ocean, listen to the waves crash below and select from an ocean-to-table menu, where the best of the local fishermen’s catch is prepared by Executive Chef Gustavo Pinet in an open air kitchen

claims.text: A saltwater meditation pool is reached directly from the spa's private treatment rooms.

findings.quote: Complete your spa journey with a cleansing dip in the saltwater meditation pool, directly accessed from your private treatment room.

claims.text: The Agave Study at Peacock Alley offers tastings of agave spirits, from tequila in Jalisco to mezcal in Oaxaca.

findings.quote: Agave Study at Peacock Alley
Explore agave spirits from tequila in Jalisco to mezcal in Oaxaca, and every plant in the lands between.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes that because the resort faces the Pacific, strong waves and a constant undercurrent mean ocean swimming is prohibited.

findings.quote: The resort is set along the Pacific Ocean (not the Sea of Cortez, which tends to be calmer), so strong waves and a constant undercurrent make ocean swimming prohibited here.

claims.text: The resort sits in a secluded enclave behind a private mountain tunnel, with very little within walking distance.

findings.quote: Tucked behind a private mountain tunnel in an exclusive residential enclave comprised of luxury homes and villas, it offers absolute seclusion, but very little within walking distance.

claims.text: Because of the cliffside location and multi-level design, travelers with limited mobility may encounter challenges.

findings.quote: due to the hotel’s cliffside location and multi-level design, travelers with limited mobility may encounter challenges
